sourceFacts.fact: Night terrors occur during deep non-REM sleep, usually in the first few hours.

sources.title: NHS children’s health: Sleepwalking, nightmares and night terrors

sourceFacts.fact: Nightmares occur during REM sleep, often later in the night.

sources.title: NHS children’s health: Sleepwalking, nightmares and night terrors

sourceFacts.fact: Children usually do not recall a night terror; they can awaken fully and recall a nightmare.
